summary: Added a lifecycle effect driver and mount wrapper around the existing compiled host, plus strict-by-default effectPolicy and neutral cancelEffect APIs with correlation and queue cleanup. Go uses the compiler-supported fixture.request kind for lookup and a distinct lifecycle.cancel intent. Focused shared-host and lifecycle driver suites pass 29/29 and 3/3 on Node v22.23.4.

focused_tests.warning: Node emitted the existing experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.
Node emitted the existing experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.

coverage: The generic host remains strict when no effectPolicy is supplied; custom policy is synchronous and receives a frozen copy of validated effect fields.
Compiler-supported fixture.request/lookup and explicit lifecycle.cancel/cancel effects are closed to the frozen name/reply/token ABI; the effect.request-reply capability gate remains enabled.
Go cancellation removes the pending runtime correlation and any queued completion without invoking Update.
The deterministic driver preserves request/cancel order, routes normal replies, records forced retired callback rejection, and releases outstanding callback closures at unmount.

limits: No Go emission or compiler build was run in the N2 runtime lane because a Go executable was unavailable there.
Mounted React/DOM lifecycle integration and browser oracle remain with the harness/browser lanes.
